SELECT url, note AS title, content FROM topic_sources WHERE topic_id = '{{ $('取成稿').first().json.topic_id }}'

UPDATE drafts SET facts = '{{ $json.facts_s }}'::jsonb, risk_flags = '{{ $json.risk_s }}'::jsonb, body_html = '{{ $json.body_html_s }}', status = '{{ $json.draft_status }}' WHERE id = {{ $json.draft_id }} RETURNING id, status;
